state.background: Phase 6 batch B12 transfers exactly two Plan45 tooltip/chartNote scenarios to Browser Mode: p45-b-tooltip-dismiss-307-viewport-chartnote-tooltip-tooltip-chartnote-tooltip (#307) and p45-b-tooltip-dismiss-430-tooltip-chartnote-tooltip (#430). Both use a 412x915 Pixel 7 Chromium touch context, the shared __MOUNT_ALL__ fixture, and the production route. #307 deliberately engineers overlap rather than claiming a natural production overlap: it opens a tooltip through a hit-tested live chart bar, moves the actual chartNote link under the live tooltip with positive geometry, confirms hit-testing at the overlap resolves to the tooltip, then uses a real touchscreen tap and asserts the nominal hash does not navigate and the tooltip remains visible. The source's temporary inline link styling is preserved and restored exactly in a finally path. #430 taps a live chart bar, identifies an actual chartNote link point inside the link and outside the tooltip, hit-tests that point, then performs a touchscreen tap and asserts nominal hash navigation and tooltip dismissal. Independent implementation and post-cutover source audits passed. Focused Browser Mode passed 2/2; post-cutover residual E2E completed build/type-check and passed 6 with 10 skipped. Starting from B11 M=118, B12 advances M to 120; 30 of 33 eligible Phase 6 scenarios are accepted and 3 remain Playwright-owned. Existing unknown-provenance changes from P42 #231 (two post-wheel assertion removals) and an unattributed desktop hover-dismiss test deletion remain separate and outside B12.
acceptanceCriteria: Both B12 stable IDs preserve the mapped source hit-testing and touch-navigation contracts in permanent fail-on-contract Browser Mode tests under the declared Pixel 7 context, shared fixture, and production route.

#307 is explicitly treated as an engineered overlap case: it uses the actual link and tooltip, confirms tooltip top-hit at their forced overlap, taps by touchscreen, verifies no nominal hash navigation and tooltip remains visible, and restores the exact original inline style in finally. It does not claim this overlap occurs naturally in production.
#430 verifies a real chartNote link hit point inside the actual link but outside the tooltip, touchscreen taps it, then checks nominal hash navigation and tooltip hidden.
Only the two mapped B12 cases are included in this batch; existing unknown-provenance P42 #231 assertions and desktop hover-dismiss test deletion remain separate and are not counted in B12.

Focused Browser Mode and post-cutover residual E2E gates pass, and independent implementation/source-boundary audits support the cutover; ledger advances from M=118 to M=120, with 30 accepted and 3 pending out of 33.
verification: Focused run `pnpm run test:browser:phase6-b12:built` passed one file / two tests. Durable log: results/plan45/phase6/phase6-b12-browser-mode-validation-pass2-2026-09-27.log.

After source cutover, residual `pnpm test:e2e:fresh` completed build/type-check and passed 6 tests with 10 skipped and zero failures. Durable log: results/plan45/phase6/phase6-b12-residual-e2e-validation-2026-09-27.log.
Independent implementation and post-cutover source-boundary audits passed.
knownConstraints: This checkpoint covers B12 only. B13 remains pending and is not included in M.
#307 overlap is intentionally engineered and does not demonstrate natural tooltip/chartNote collision in the production layout.
Two removed post-wheel assertions from P42 #231 and an unattributed desktop hover-dismiss test deletion have unknown provenance; they remain outside B12 and are not counted as transferred.
state.outputRequirement: Choose exactly one criterion for this implementation checkpoint. Provide effective verdict, decision summary and full choice distribution, evidence tied to B12 IDs and artifact paths, any required correction with exact location, and remaining uncertainty. Distinguish the engineered #307 overlap from natural production behavior. Keep unrelated unknown-provenance changes separate from B12 accounting. Do not promote partial ownership or feasibility evidence to a full migration. If the initial choice is not valid_as_defined, follow exactly one required case-specific clarification and preserve the initial result; do not turn a non-pass into a pass.

implementation.instructions: Evaluate whether B12 is a valid full cutover under the acceptance criteria and evidence. Select the single best matching criterion.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The supplied source-contract, cutover, ledger, and verification evidence supports accepting B12 as defined.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: A concrete conflict exists between requirements and implementation or recorded evidence; identify the requirement and requirement-only correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Required prerequisite information is missing; identify exactly what is needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: Specific evidence needed to assess B12 is missing; identify the exact gap.
criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete implementation or reporting defect violates a criterion; name the location, evidence, and implementation-only correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The cutover exceeds or falls outside the agreed batch boundary; identify the boundary and adjustment.
criteria.other: A different concrete validity issue exists; state the finding, location, evidence, and next action.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied context cannot support a decision; identify the missing context and resolving evidence.
